# Native Pyramid objective references

The native-123-provenance.json additions are exact full Twos-word, Fours-title
and Continue crops from retained 2.8.123 failures. They extend finite appearance
banks while preserving all existing thresholds. Their unchanged originals are
also retained under ../pyramid-recon/native-v21; they are exposed regressions,
not holdouts or fresh live acceptance. Other missing rank labels remain absent.

The exposed native-v20 correction retains the unchanged Star Club Boards 2/2
Challenge Complete original as `boards-complete-continue.png`, its whole
Continue/header crops, and the genuine Fours XP skip-instruction crop. Exact
sources and hashes are in
[native-v20 provenance](../pyramid-recon/native-v20/provenance.json).
These support endpoint/control recognition; fresh Continuous verification for
Boards, Score, Twos, Fours and Sevens remains a separate live requirement.

These five originals are retained unchanged because the supplied Screenshots
directory and the first-failure packet directory are cleanable. Exact original
paths, byte counts and SHA-256 values are in [provenance.json](provenance.json).
Every original is a single native 1920×1080 PNG. This finite calibration corpus
does not establish live Continuous, challenge-completion or restart acceptance.

- `fours-four-of-twelve.png`: actual centred Fours-cleared 4/12 objective.
- `boards-zero-of-two.png`: actual centred Boards-cleared 0/2 objective.
- `normal-one.png`: supplied normal Boards: 1 of 3 reference.
- `solver-layout.png`: separate built-in Solver banner/bar, retained as a
  negative for objective-counter interpretation.
- `normal-grandmaster-refused.png`: exact last observed frame in the release
  2.7.118 entry failure. Its ordinal-one header passes the existing tolerance
  of 12. Its New footer exceeds the original reference tolerance of 10 at
  exactly three pixels, each with maximum channel difference 11.

`footer-new-grandmaster.rgb` is the complete row-major RGB8 crop
`[212,998,58,31]` of that last original, including all background and antialiased
pixels. Its length is 5,394 bytes. The normal reader accepts either complete
measured footer appearance at the existing inclusive tolerance of 10. Header
tolerance, scene checks and input authority do not change.

The exact differing native coordinates relative to the original footer are
`(265,1012)`, `(243,1013)` and `(262,1020)`. No pixels were masked, repainted,
resized or generated. Synthetic test corruptions remain labelled as derivatives.
